title: Compute multiway and range-versus-range equity within 1.5 points
description:
As a learner, I want equity against several opponents' ranges that is as accurate as heads-up equity, so that postflop advice in multiway pots is trustworthy.

Completes REQ-034: multiway and range-versus-range results within 1.5 percentage points of an exhaustive or high-sample reference computed offline and stored with the method used. Together with the heads-up set from E07-S02 the matchup suite holds at least 200 matchups.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-034 (Must): Equity calculation accuracy — The equity calculator shall return each hand's equity against one or more ranges within 1.5 percentage points of the exact value.

Covers: REQ-034

## Notes
Reference values are generated by an offline script committed with the data so they can be regenerated.

Plan key: E07-S06 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a stored set of at least 100 multiway and range-versus-range cases on boards of 0, 3, 4 and 5 cards with offline reference values, When the equity test suite runs, Then every result is within 1.5 percentage points of its reference [REQ-034.2]

Given the heads-up and multiway reference sets, When the equity test suite runs, Then it contains at least 200 matchups and each reference value records whether it was exhaustive or high-sample [REQ-034.1, REQ-034.2]
Given the same ranges listed in a different order, When equity is computed, Then the result is identical [REQ-034.3]
